observations.notes: The packaged Tauri UI used a local HTTP CMS fixture only to return the real public DASH MPD. The Rust proxy rewrote the MPD and preserved the SegmentTemplate token; after a native video play gesture, WebView2 displayed real video and advanced from 0:00 to 0:04. This proves the non-DRM DASH proxy/player path, not ClearKey EME acceptance.
